scope: Eight-direction M1 animation atlases for player, Dasher, Archer and Minion

production_summary.west_policy: west and left-facing diagonals are exact horizontal mirrors of their right-facing counterparts
production_summary.diagonal_policy: integer-shift opaque pixel composites derived from approved cardinal poses

runtime_checks.direction_selection: deterministic eight-sector quantization with 22.5/67.5 degree boundaries and persisted last facing
runtime_checks.player_states: movement, dash, blessing selection, hit and death drive visible clips
runtime_checks.enemy_states: attack state machine phases drive charge, execute, recover and basic attack clips
runtime_checks.initial_facing: player north; authored enemy facing or player-relative fallback
runtime_checks.non_looping_clips: hold their final frame until runtime state changes
runtime_checks.pause_behavior: frame playback uses scaled delta time
runtime_checks.telegraph_readability: line strokes encode attack width without filling the whole collision corridor
runtime_checks.hud_sorting: screen-space camera HUD is explicitly on the UI sorting layer

screenshots.state: initial north-facing player and mixed enemy directions

human_review_remaining: Confirm costume-detail consistency between approved south poses and generated north/east poses.
Confirm derived diagonal composites read clearly at gameplay scale or commission dedicated diagonal key poses.
Confirm the deterministic whole-silhouette motion density is sufficient before commissioning hand-authored limb animation.
Approve or request revisions to individual role/direction key poses.
scope_note: No Echo, Golem, hazard, destructible, final-room, M2 or marketing feature was produced because no valid user-owned M2EntryGate PASS exists.
